title: [A11Y] Guide sections stay without accessible names

note.summary: This backlog decision records an observation deliberately not changed 2026-07-28. Guide sections remain unnamed because turning all of them into named landmarks would create rotor noise rather than help.
note.goal: Preserve unnamed guide sections unless real screen-reader users provide evidence to change the decision.
note.whyItMatters: The record prevents a reflexive accessibility change that would make long guide pages noisier for screen-reader navigation.
note.filesToTouch: none — decision ticket
note.readExactly: AGENTS.md, TASKVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, this ticket
note.constraints: Each guide page has 10 `<section class="guide-block">` with no `aria-label`, no `aria-labelledby` and no `id` on the `h2`s, so they map to `generic` rather than `region`. Adding `aria-labelledby` would turn them into 10 named landmarks per page, which is rotor noise, not help. Screen-reader users navigate long documents by heading, and the headings are correct and complete. Confirm the decision during real AT testing; do not "fix" it reflexively.
doneWhen: the existing decision remains recorded
the decision is re-opened only with evidence from real screen-reader users
note.priorityRationale: Low because the behaviour is already deliberately decided and only needs confirmation during real AT testing.
